connectors.description_en: QCC Legal is a Chinese legal-data connector for searching, researching, and verifying statutes and judicial cases. On the regulation side it covers the full body of in-force Chinese law — laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules, judicial interpretations, and local regulations — at both the whole-regulation and individual-article level, returning verbatim text tagged with validity status (in force / amended / repealed), legal hierarchy, and promulgating authority, with common-name normalization (e.g. the Civil Code, the Personal Information Protection Law). On the case side it covers a massive corpus of ordinary judgment documents plus 25,000+ authoritative cases — Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate guiding cases, gazette cases, typical cases, and reference cases — filterable by cause of action, court, instance, judgment date, and party. It further verifies legal citations: given any text it detects every statute and case-number reference, checks each against the database, flags validity status, returns the authoritative source and verbatim text, and generates traceable hyperlinks — eliminating fabricated statutes and case numbers in AI-generated legal content. Use natural language to find statutory grounds, run legal research and analysis, retrieve similar cases, pull verbatim originals, and verify citations before delivery.
connectors.description: Search and verify Chinese statutes and judicial cases through natural language. Integrated providers include Perplexity, Tavily, Exa, Firecrawl, and Linkup. The platform also supports searches for research papers, academic literature, citation relationships, and patent information; social media content and data queries for X (Twitter), YouTube, and TikTok; and searches for GitHub repositories, code, and developer documentation.E-commerce: Access data related to Douyin, TikTok Shop, Taobao, Tmall, JD.com, Xiaohongshu (RED), Xianyu (Goofish), 1688, Amazon, Shopee, Temu, and other platforms. Services such as Chanmama, Kalodata, and Sorftime provide insights into products, stores, creators, livestreams, and sales performance, supporting product sourcing and selection for domestic and cross-border markets, supplier discovery, market research, and competitor analysis.Other Services: Access mapping and weather services such as Amap and QWeather, with support for place searches, geocoding, and global and local weather queries to assist with travel planning. Additional capabilities include optical character recognition (OCR), document parsing, content extraction from PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files, and searches for film, television, and job-related information(AgentEarth).

connectors.name: yihook
connectors.description_zh: 通过 yihook 账号生成图片、解析商品、分析爆款视频、增强视频、制作 UGC 与商品智能成片并查询结果。 开发候选支持照片数字人口播与视频口型同步的上传录音与文案配音路线，配音和视频分阶段确认费用。 开发候选支持Amazon广告图片多尺寸适配：识别并编辑文案、选择尺寸、确认费用后生成。 支持本地上传或链接参考视频及商品素材，展示参考分析、确认结构及费用后，批量制作商品克隆与改编视频。 支持 Seedance 2.0 角色参考汽车营销短视频，生成前统一确认完整方案与费用。 支持单条本地视频翻译配音与三种口型处理方式，免费预检并确认费用后执行。 支持本地3—60分钟长视频高光提取，确认画幅、字幕和费用后生成一条主片段并查询下载。 支持查看AI研策周期赠分与席位，首次购买并独立确认绑定社媒监测席位，查询账号概览、已采集作品及单条指标；商品解析和爆款分析展示专用积分优先、通用积分补差的报价与结算；取消和席位变更到网页操作。 支持上传主播与商品图，使用 Yi Image 2.5 Pro 编辑一张绿幕或直播间持品商拍图，含固定构图底图，免费估价并确认费用后制作。 支持上传真实商品照，以 Seedream 5.0 Pro 制作一张白底棚拍、生活场景或品牌氛围静物图，确认比例和真实费用后生成并直接交付。 支持根据人像或文字，以 Yi Image 2.5 Pro 制作一张9:16、2K空手主播形象图；选择绿幕或品类直播间，免费估价并确认费用后生成。 支持用人物图与服饰图制作全身试穿主图；没有人物图时用悠船V8.2创建模特，再用Yi Image 2.5 Pro试穿，先确认两阶段完整费用。人物按实际尺寸、试穿默认3:4及2K，沿用随包浅灰摄影背景。 支持文字定制原创电商模特，悠船V8.2首轮四候选自动选一张，再用Yi Image 2.5 Pro制作一张9:16、2K四宫格模卡，先确认完整费用；人物使用原生分辨率，保留身份的模卡修改单独核价。
connectors.description_en: Generate images, extract products, analyze and enhance videos, create UGC and smart product videos with your Yihook account. Development candidate includes photo avatars and video lip sync with uploaded audio or text-to-speech, with separate voice and video budget confirmation. Development candidate also supports Amazon ad image resizing after copy editing, size selection and cost confirmation. Adapt locally uploaded or linked reference videos for products after reviewing the reference analysis and confirming structure and cost. Create automotive marketing videos with Seedance 2.0 character reference after confirming the full plan and cost. Translate one local video with fast dubbing, fast lip sync or precision lip sync after a free quote and cost confirmation. Extract one highlight clip from a local 3–60 minute video after confirming aspect ratio, captions and cost, then query and download the result. View AI Research period credits and seats, purchase your first plan, separately confirm a social monitoring account, and query overviews, collected posts and post metrics. Product parsing and viral analysis show research-first and general-credit top-up quotes and settlement. Manage cancellations and seat changes on the website. Create one green-screen or livestream host product photo with Yi Image 2.5 Pro from host and product images plus the bundled composition base, after a free estimate and cost confirmation. Create one still-life product photo with Seedream 5.0 Pro after confirming image type, aspect ratio and cost, then deliver the generated image directly. Create one empty-handed host avatar image from a portrait or text with Yi Image 2.5 Pro at 9:16 and 2K, choosing a green screen or category livestream studio and confirming the cost first. Create a full-body fashion try-on from model and garment images. Without a model photo, create a model with Midjourney V8.2 and then dress them with Yi Image 2.5 Pro after confirming the full two-stage cost. Deliver the model at native size and the try-on at 3:4 and 2K with the bundled grey studio background. Design an original e-commerce model, automatically select one of the first four Midjourney V8.2 portraits, and create one 9:16 2K four-panel model card with Yi Image 2.5 Pro after confirming the complete cost. Portraits use native resolution; model-card changes can retain the selected identity.
